facts.business: Midland Polymers Limited is currently in transition from its existing polymer business to diversified infrastructure activities including electrical power transmission and distribution, underground cabling, rural and urban electrification, renewable energy projects, defence infrastructure, and irrigation and water management projects on EPC, turnkey and contractual basis.

facts.related_party_note: The Company has formulated a Policy on Related Party Transactions in line with Companies Act, 2013 and Listing Regulations to ensure proper reporting, approval and disclosure processes for all transactions between the Company and Related Parties.
